# Teemous Digital Lab

> Teemous Digital Lab is a specialized digital identity & AI creative engineering lab founded by Ngô Quang Sinh in Da Nang, Vietnam. It engineers bespoke digital portfolio hubs, autonomous AI agent workflows, and turnkey cloud infrastructure for ambitious Gen Z builders, students, and young professionals.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Living Portfolio Hubs: High-performance, bespoke personal branding and portfolio websites replacing flat PDF resumes with verified credentials and proof of work.
- Autonomous AI Agents: Purpose-built conversational AI agents answering recruiter questions 24/7 and specialized workflow automation tools.
- Turnkey Digital Infrastructure: Scalable edge deployment on custom domains with Cloudflare security.
- Social Media Growth Terminal: Strategic engagement acceleration across Meta & TikTok ecosystems.

## Flagship Portfolio Showcase
- Trần Thị Thùy Dương: Software Engineering & Algorithms (VKU, Top 6 SheCodes, ICPC National).
- Lê Thái Trung: Backend Development & Distributed Architecture.
- Ngô Quang Sinh: Founder, AI Automation & Digital Systems (Duy Tân University).
- Bùi Lưu Bảo Hân: HR Operations & Community Building.
